preamble: The shift from the glottal fricative [h] to the velar stop [k] is a form of fortition (strengthening).

examples.note: Initial laryngeal *H > k in Arin; Pumpokol has h, and Ket and Yugh have zero (уль ūlʲ)
cf. Pumpokol híneang, Ket ын ɨ̄n

sources: Braune, W., & Reiffenstein, I. (2004). Althochdeutsche Grammatik I: Laut- und Formenlehre (15th ed.). Max Niemeyer / De Gruyter. https://doi.org/10.1515/9783110930887
